title: Monday.com lays off hundreds to focus on AI
slides: What does Monday.com know that its users don't?
It just laid off 200 employees to double down on AI.
Most project management tools ignore AI under the hood.
Your workflows may soon automate without you lifting a finger.
Test Monday.com's new AI features before competitors do.
thread_text:
They knew before you did.

Monday.com just cut 200 jobs to invest in AI — the same AI users weren't told about under the hood.

The hidden layer.

Most project management tools now run AI on your workflows — but they never tell you, and never ask.

The real shift.

Soon your tasks will be assigned, rescheduled, and closed automatically — with zero input from you.

Control or convenience?

If the tool decides what's urgent, do you still own your priorities — or does the algorithm own them?

Test it yourself this week.

Open Monday.com and trigger its new AI scheduler on a real project. Does it save time or create rework?
